messages:
Noor: Hey team, first day remote from Barcelona. Laptop arrived but the charger plug is a US Type A and my outlet is Type C. I expected an EU plug per my address. Charger also shows the battery LED flickering when plugged in and laptop battery isn't charging past 2%. Anyone seen this? Shipping tag: EU-ONB-0921.

michael_it: Welcome Noor! Sorry about that. Quick Qs: 1) can you confirm the charger part number on the brick? 2) is the LED on the brick solid, blinking, or off when connected?

Noor: Brick label: RW-90W-USB-C v1.2. LED blinks amber slowly when connected, laptop shows AC connected but battery charging: 0% -> 2% then stops. I tried two outlets and a power strip.

michael_it: Blinking LED + stops at low percent sounds like either a faulty brick or the wrong plug adapter causing intermittent contact. Two actions: 1) try an SMC/PMU reset (MacBook Intel) or SMC-equivalent on Apple silicon (hold power 10s until reboot) and retry; 2) we'll escalate and send an EU replacement brick + Type A->C adapter return label. Can you attach a photo of the brick label and the plug?

Noor: Did the reboot trick (held power >10s) 11 rebooted but same behavior. Photo: https://files.redwood.internal/up/noor_brick.jpg  Also noticed a faint scorch mark on the plug plastic.

it-bot: New IT ticket #46234 created: "Charger wrong region + intermittent charging / possible damaged plug" assigned to michael_it.

michael_it: Thanks for the media. Don't use the brick if you see scorch marks. I'll mark this high priority. Emma from facilities will arrange an international ship.

emma-facilities: Hi @Noor, we'll ship an EU-compatible 90W brick and a tested USB-C cable today via DHL Express. Please confirm your shipping address (masked in HR profile). We will include a prepaid return label for the faulty brick and the original cable pouch. ETA 3-4 business days. If you are near an authorized electronics store and need a temporary charger, let us know and we'll approve reimbursement up to $40.

Noor: Confirmed my HR address is correct. Thanks, prefer company ship. One more thing 1 I can't see Redwood-Onboarding Wi-Fi in the office list when I visit our Barcelona coworking space. It only shows a captive portal for the landlord. Is there a separate onboarding cert for international offices?

michael_it: Good call. For vendor/coworking spaces we don't push certs automatically. Onboarding Wi-Fi is 802.1X/EAP using our corp cert. If you're at a Redwood partner space, you'll need to use Guest + VPN for now. I can open a temporary exception for your device while we ship hardware. Also, who do you need to contact for Slack workspace invites?

Noor: Got it. Guest+VPN works for now. I clicked request for #eng-general but the access request is stuck in pending.

michael_it: I'll escalate access once your device shows as compliant in Intune. For now, ping @onboarding in DMs and mention ticket #46234, we'll fast-track.

emma-facilities: Shipping arranged, tracking will be posted to the ticket. Please don't use the damaged brick and keep it in the original box until pickup. We'll include a small EU plug kit and a spare Kensington lock if you want one.

Noor: Thanks everyone 1 appreciate the quick help. Will wait for tracking and use Guest+VPN till then. :thumbsup:
